name: Eberouge Special ~Koi to Mahou no Gakuen Seikatsu~
original_name: エーベルージュ スペシャル ～恋と魔法の学園生活～
source:
Main character is a 15-years old student who arrives at the magic school. He will meet different female teachers and classmates that he can date there provided that he has required skill levels.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名来到魔法学校的15岁学生。他会遇到不同的女老师和女同学，只要他具备所需的技能水平，他就可以在那里约会。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
